title: Shift exit labels
statement: For natural-number parameters $a,b,f$, define the exit label for each of the four shift sites by sending the $N$, $M$, and $K$ sites to the copy sites for $m:=n$, $k:=m$, and $q:=p$, respectively, and the $T$ site to phase $0$ of the subtraction site that leaves the target coordinate.
